name: How long does window air leak repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does window air leak repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of window air leak repair depends on the number of windows needing service and the complexity of the leaks. For a typical home with several windows needing re-caulking and weatherstripping, the repair might be completed within a day. More extensive repairs involving multiple windows or structural adjustments could take longer. We will provide a clear timeline during your initial consultation after assessing the scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time depends on the number of windows and leak complexity. Most repairs for a typical home can be completed within a day, with longer times for extensive work.
